strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
We're in a hurry, so is it really okay to stop at Luna II for supplies again?
Now, now, don't get so worked up, Pai.
I don't get it either. After all that rushing us around...
I'd like to hurry too... but catching the colony with empty tanks
wouldn't do us any good, would it?
Well, yeah, but still...
Mobile suits are designed to operate from a ship...
Even the Dendrobium, which can handle long operations,
has to restock the ammo it's used up.
Same goes for mobile suits, but...
the Cyber Beasts, unlike the Dangaioh,
weren't built to travel between the stars.
Sara! If you're done, quit yapping and give me a hand!
Oh, shut up! You're just slow, aren't you!?
If you've got time to run your mouth, get your hands moving!
Yikes... That lady's scarier than Lenny...
Whatever. Let's finish resupplying and catch that colony!
We can't afford to dawdle, right?
Those two never change, huh.
Still, I can understand why Shinobu's impatient.
Yes... We have to save Earth, and soon...
Don't be too hasty. Looks like everyone's resupply is almost done.
Enemy attack!? Did they chase us all the way here!?
...It's tough being popular.
This is no time for jokes... It's a mobile suit squad, but these units...!
...! Haman, curse you...
Whoa, whoa, these machines... aren't most of them what the Titans used!?
The Titans... Weren't they the ones from that last war...
Yes, they're the ones Captain Bright and the others defeated.
The Titans? Heh... So the losers
came to pay Captain Bright back?
Come to think of it... thanks to Captain Bright's crew, the Titans
supposedly lost the Gryps Conflict...
So Neo Zeon has gathered up the remnants...?
It's possible, but...
They're still the enemy, right!? Lenny, Mike! You two resupplied?
Of course!
Ready anytime, Big Bro!
I was bored waiting on everyone else's resupply. Let's go!
Let's go too, Mia, Lamba!
Yes!
Wait for meee, everyone!
What!? I see... Londo Bell. I figured they were chasing the colony,
but they were hanging around here!
As a warm-up before our descent to Earth, I meant to bring down
the Federation's space fortress... but it seems this may take some work.
Who cares. ...Looks like they've got a few Gundam types, too...
I'll be paying them back for what I owe them...!
Easy, Lieutenant Jerid... Lady Haman took in you Titans remnants
for a reason. Don't forget that.
...Then fire me, or shoot me in the back.
...I'm settling the score from Gryps. ...I can't pass up a chance like this...!
...Good grief.
...It seems I may need to borrow your strength as well...
I don't mind. I believe I understand my role.
Heh... I'm counting on you...
(But... what... is this... feeling?)
Ugh... wh-what...?
...What is this feeling... Is someone watching me...?
Tch, whatever's out there, if I kill them all, that'll be the end of it!
And this sick feeling of mine... I'll wipe it all out...! Here I come!
Aaah...!
Damn!! Is my combat instinct still not back...!?
I'll eliminate this threat at its root...!
Damn, I can't fall before the descent to Earth...! I have to get him... him!
...Him...!? It can't be...!
Descend to Earth...? Wait!
Took too much damage...? Hmph, no matter.
We'll call it a good warm-up.
You're running away, you jerk!?
Fighting any longer would affect our descent to Earth.
...Simply holding Londo Bell here is good enough for now...
So we were just a test of skill? How rude.
I've found you... Dangaioh!
Everyone, look! That's...!!
Hm...? Hey, that's the Bunker!
What...? Hm, the Bunker!?
Them...!? Are they still after Earth!?
So the space pirates show up... I'm counting on you, Raideen!
They haven't shown themselves in a while... but here they are!
Heh, I figured you'd run off from the Earth Sphere.
Silence! I don't have time to waste
on a bunch I can crush whenever I like!
So you've appeared again... Is the Bunker plotting something new...?
You're here too... Surely you know the law of the Bunker.
For traitors, there is only death!
Silence! I've awakened from that nightmare!
So those are the space pirates...
Looks like they're hostile to Londo Bell, too...
Space pirates... As long as they don't get in our way,
we should avoid interfering for now.
If you're so busy, why go out of your way to come mess with us!?
No kidding. No need to come all the way out here!
Heh heh heh... If it were just you lot, I might've let you go...
but with Dangaioh... with Mia Alice here, it's another story!
Gil! Why do you go this far to come after us...
I told you, Mia Alice! You, of all people, I will never forgive...!
This one's got some deep roots, huh...
Keep that up and you know what people will call you?
There's a word for guys like you: stalker!
Say what you like, I won't listen! You'll be turned to dust here!
Ngh... the Bloody...!? ...Very well, I'll let you go for today!
Gil! You're running away!?
For all that big talk, you sure run fast! Gimme a break!
Hmph... I can't let my obsession with you ruin my operation on Earth.
Earth!? You're going down to Earth again?
Gil...! What are you doing on Earth...
That's none of your concern... But remember this.
I will have your heads, without fail!
Mia Alice... on a fitting stage...!
Gil... going to Earth...
He seemed to be plotting something...
Tch, whatever it is, it's no good.
Maybe Dr. Tarsan would know something if we asked.
Right... I'll send the doctor a report on our situation.
Mia, don't let it get to you. He's just one member of the Bunker.
This feeling...? There's... another Ple!?
What? Another... me? No, that's not it... What is this grating feeling...
I knew it! You're Ple! ...Well, no, but you're another Ple!
You! What are you saying!? I'm Ple Two!
Come with me! Ple... no, Ple Two!
You can't let people like that use you!
Judau, you're too close! What are you doing!?
Stay out of this! Ple Two! Don't you get it!?
That's not where you belong!
(Empathy between Newtypes? What they once felt...
...is Judau Ashta sensing it too?)
Wh-what are you...? Stop... stop confusing me!
I can't quite hear, but... is that Ple!?
But there's no way Ple would be here...
Ple Two!
I am... Ple Two...! A soldier of Zeon...!
Heavy damage... Londo Bell... I didn't think they'd go this far...!
Ple Two!
You again!? I told you not to touch my mind...!
Be more honest with your own heart. You're not that kind of kid!
Ngh... uuh... ugh...
Nobody's going to hurt you!
Do you want to die as nothing but someone's tool!?
Judau! What are you doing!? We're in the middle of a battle!
I can't watch Judau like this! Hey, Bright, I'm gonna go drag him off.
Wait, Fujiwara. Captain, let's leave this to Judau.
Captain?
...There's no need to repeat the same mistake. If it can be avoided, that is.
Ple Two... come on, let's go together...
...Judau... Judau Ashta...
...Ugh!
What...!? This awful feeling...
I knew it... that guy...! ...Dammit!
(Ngh...! ...Is history repeating itself...!?)
Phew... Looks like we finally drove them all off.
Jeez, some resupply stop that turned out to be.
We managed to protect Luna II, but... now we have to redo the resupply.
But... the enemy commanders and officers got away...
Titans remnants and the Bunker...
We may have let some troublesome foes slip away...
It'll be fine, Brother. I'm sure the Gandor crew will handle it.
The Zeon guys... looked like their commander's heading down to Earth...
Hey, you. Don't you know what they're after?
I only came out to crush you. I don't know anything else.
Being so loyal to your duty sure backfires at times like this.
Hmm... Sending troops to Earth at the same time as the colony drop...
What are they plotting?
(Lieutenant Jerid...)
They sure are thorough, dammit.
And now another resupply... What a pain.
Can't be helped, Shinobu. It's not like we can have energy
beamed to us the way the Nadesico does.
But it bothers me... The Bunker also seemed to be heading for Earth...
I doubt they and Zeon share the same goal.
Mia... I know how you feel, but we can't go after him now.
We have to...
I know... I know, Roll...
Right now we have to hurry to the colony...!
But letting the Bunker run wild on Earth isn't great either...
We'll discuss that later. If we could send our forces to Earth instantly,
it'd be different, but given the time a descent takes, it's not realistic.
For now, we press on...!
